text: Good evening. I am the grandfather of Ananya, she is 4 years old, staying with us this week while her parents are out of station. Temperature I have checked just now, it is 37.9. I want to know how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give her, and which one is better. Please tell me the exact amount in ml, I have the children's syrup bottle here but the printing is very small and I don't want to do any guesswork. Weeing she is doing properly, she has gone to the toilet two-three times this evening itself, so I think that side is okay. One more thing, her legs and arms have some red spots, but these are mosquito bites only. She was playing in the garden full day yesterday and the mosquitoes are very bad there. She is scratching them and complaining of itching, same bites my wife also got. I am only mentioning so you don't ask later. Kindly just tell me the dose, I think that is all I need.
